legalLicenseName: CENTRAL VALLEY TRAINING CENTER VALLEY S

facilityDetails.programFocus: Central Valley Training Center, Inc. provides person-centered services to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities, including those with challenging behaviors. The program focuses on vocational training, community integration, and skill development in areas such as social skills, pedestrian safety, public transportation, budgeting, and self-advocacy. Individual Service Plans are developed to support participants in reaching their full potential.

facilityDetails.programFocus: The Campus Program provides individuals with disabilities exposure to a variety of social, recreational, and vocational opportunities within their community, focusing on program-based skill building and community integration. Participants learn basic life and vocational skills and are exposed to a range of trainings designed to help them develop new interests.

parentReviews: The Arc of Amador and Calaveras has served individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities since 1971.
It offers a Campus Program with social, recreational, and vocational opportunities, emphasizing community integration.
The program holds its 9th consecutive Three-Year CARF Accreditation for its quality services.
